author: Home Repair Tutor
description: I’m installing 24 x 48 porcelain on this bathroom wall. The 3/8” x 1/2” notched trowel is a great size because it provides 95% thin-set coverage. The edging tool also removes excess mortar off the tile and metal profile, which keeps the grout joints clean.
title: Wall Tile Installation Tips in a Bathroom - #shorts #tileshower #sponsored
